verdict.rationale: Parsec documents a high-performance relay for Enterprise customers that lets a team connect through a relay point inside their own firewall, which approximates self-hosting the relay. It also states that connections are peer-to-peer and never pass through Parsec's infrastructure. The support is a single thin, Enterprise-only mention, and nothing shows whether rendezvous/signaling can run on customer infrastructure. Missing for 10: explicit self-hosted relay deployment docs, self-hostable rendezvous/signaling, availability below the Enterprise tier, independent or hands-on corroboration.
